name: WeRead Note Sync
settingDescription: Fetches notes via the official WeRead Agent API Gateway only; nothing is sent anywhere else.
settingApiKeyPlaceholder: WeRead Agent API Key starting with wrk-
settingApiKeyHint: Used only to call the official WeRead Agent API Gateway (i.weread.qq.com); never sent to any other address.
settingStorageNotice: When "Remember" is checked, the key is stored in plain text in this device's window.localStorage (key name weread-note-sync.apiKey): per-frontend local storage, not encrypted, never synced through the SiYuan kernel; unchecking or clicking "Clear Key" deletes it. Otherwise the key lives only in the current session memory and disappears when the plugin is reloaded or disabled.
settingInvalidKey: Invalid API Key: it must start with "wrk-", be at least 12 characters in total, and contain no spaces or line breaks.
settingFailKindAuth: Authentication failed: the API Key is invalid or expired. Please check and retry.
settingFailKindNetwork: Network error: cannot reach the WeRead gateway. Please check your network and retry.
settingFailKindUpgrade: WeRead requires an upgrade: follow the prompt, then retry.
settingFailKindGateway: Gateway error: the WeRead gateway returned an abnormal response. Please retry later.
settingFailKindInvalidKey: Invalid API Key: it must start with "wrk-" and be at least 12 characters in total.
settingFailUnexpected: Connection test hit an unexpected error. Please retry.
settingKeyCleared: API Key cleared (session memory and local storage).
settingAccountHint: Names the WeRead account bound to synced notes (part of content identity). Changing the API Key does NOT change the account; if you really switched accounts, edit this label explicitly.
syncNeedApiKey: Please configure a valid WeRead API Key in Settings first.
syncNeedAccount: Please configure an account label in Settings first.
syncKeyChangedWarning: The API Key differs from the last one used. If you switched WeRead accounts, update the account label too; a fresh key for the same account needs no action.
syncUnexpectedError: Unexpected error during sync, please retry.
syncSkippedCount: books skipped entirely (bad payload or protection mode; see skip reasons)
reviewLoadError: Failed to load pending items. Please retry later.
reviewNoMatchFilter: No items match the current filter.
reviewDiffHint: Legend: "+" with a solid underline = added in remote; "-" with strikethrough = local-only (color is a secondary cue).
reviewManualMergeHint: Edit the merged text (prefilled with the remote version); confirming writes it to the original block via the controlled update protocol.
reviewStaleNotice: Content has changed since detection; the diff was reloaded (nothing was applied). Please review again.
reviewDeferredHint: Deferred items keep their state and are not lost; they reappear after refreshing or reopening the review.
